SessionStart.bash: sh -c 'd=$(pwd); until [ -x "$d/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" ] || [ -f "$d/agnostic-ai.yaml" ] || [ -f "$d/agnostic.config.yaml" ] || [ "$d" = "$(dirname "$d")" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; bin="$d/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai"; [ -x "$bin" ] || bin=agnostic-ai; command -v "$bin" >/dev/null || exit 0; AGNOSTIC_AI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 "$bin" project --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "agnostic-ai: this version has no project command; upgrade to 0.83.0 or newer" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$bin" project -- hook memory --target copilot'
SessionStart.powershell: $d = (Get-Location).Path; $bin = 'agnostic-ai'; while ($d) { $local = Join-Path $d 'node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai.cmd'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $local) { $bin = $local; break }; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'agnostic-ai.yaml')) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'agnostic.config.yaml'))) { break }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $d; if ($parent -eq $d) { break }; $d = $parent }; if ($bin -eq 'agnostic-ai' -and !(Get-Command agnostic-ai -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { exit 0 }; $env:AGNOSTIC_AI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK = '1'; & $bin project --help *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('agnostic-ai: this version has no project command; upgrade to 0.83.0 or newer'); exit 1 }; & $bin project -- hook memory --target copilot; exit $LASTEXITCODE
